'''Technocan''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Toucanzam]] at 36 stars after completing their [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Those dazzling bright feathers always carry a neon shine. Technocan has completely mastered the destructive potential of soundwaves, releasing them at will to instantly shatter enemy defense. Also, they come in handy during concerts, when nicely-timed lightning is all you need to tear off the roof."

Technocan is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A blue and yellow-orange toucan, with a white face and yellow lightning-inspired highlights on its large wings. Its tail fans out like a peacock's. It has lighter blue feet, and a large, orange, red, and yellow bill.

Technocan's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its orange bill into magenta. The ends of its wing and tail feathers also become magenta.

==Trivia==
* Technocan was added to the game on 8/12/2026 alongside [[Cavyzap]] and [[Blastniff]].
